title: Lagniappe at Blue Mountain
meta_description: A stylish retreat in Blue Mountain Beach with outdoor kitchen, pool access, and just minutes from 30A dining and sugar-white sands.
description_expanded:
Welcome to Lagniappe at Blue Mountain by AvantStay, where modern design meets laid-back coastal living along scenic 30A. Nestled in The Village at Blue Mountain Beach, this gated retreat places you in one of South Walton's most beloved neighborhoods---minutes from sugar-white sands, charming bike paths, and the vibrant dining scene of Santa Rosa Beach.

Inside, you'll find a bright, open-concept layout perfect for gathering with friends and family. The living room invites relaxation with plush seating and a Roku-equipped TV for movie nights. Just beyond, the chef's kitchen shines with stainless steel appliances, a spacious island with seating for six, and a custom dining table for ten---ideal for group dinners after a day in the sun.

Upstairs, four thoughtfully designed bedrooms comfortably sleep ten guests. Two king suites feature private ensuite baths---one with a spa-like soaking tub---while a third king bedroom and a queen-over-queen bunk room share a Jack-and-Jill bath, creating the perfect mix of comfort and convenience for families or groups. Each bedroom comes with its own Smart TV, ensuring everyone has a space to unwind.

Step outside to discover your private alfresco haven. Fire up the full outdoor kitchen---complete with a built-in grill, griddle, sink, and refrigerator---or use the free-standing gas grill on the back patio for quick meals. Patio seating for six makes it easy to enjoy morning coffee or evening cocktails outdoors. An outdoor shower makes beach days simple, while community amenities---including a sparkling pool, bocce and shuffleboard courts, and a fitness center---are just steps away.

A secure, tech-enabled lockbox ensures seamless entry without compromising the home's hurricane-rated doors and windows.

When it's time to explore, you'll be a short walk or ride to Blue Mountain Beach, a nationally designated "Blue Wave Beach" known for its natural beauty and family-friendly atmosphere. Start your day with pastries from Blue Mountain Bakery, grab fresh seafood at Goatfeathers, or end the evening with sweet scoops from Blue Mountain Beach Creamery. Grayton Beach State Park, Seaside, and other 30A favorites are just minutes away.

Lagniappe means "a little something extra," and this home delivers exactly that---an elevated coastal escape with every detail designed to make your stay special.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach.

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- Please note that bikes are not provided. Guests may rent them through our preferred vendor, LIV Adventures.

Parking Details:
- Guests will have access to 2 driveway parking spots during their stay. Please note that street parking is not available.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
